audience.text: Developers needing metadata-safe structural inspection and limited non-rendering edits of PSD/PSB files from .NET code.

capabilities.text: Load PSD and supported PSB files from file paths or stream sources.
capabilities.title: Load PSD/PSB from file or stream

capabilities.text: Read document properties including width, height, channels, bits per channel, color mode, version, size, bounds, compression, image resources, and flatten status.
capabilities.title: Read document metadata

capabilities.text: Read and modify layer name, visibility, opacity, clipping, blend mode key, and geometry via coordinate properties.
capabilities.title: Read and modify layer metadata

capabilities.text: Preserve unsupported file sections as raw bytes during save to minimize unintended changes.
capabilities.title: Preserve unsupported sections

capabilities.text: Build and run tests using the dotnet CLI with the provided solution file.
capabilities.title: Build and test with dotnet CLI

capabilities.text: Install the Aspose.PSD.FOSS package using the dotnet CLI command.
capabilities.title: Install via dotnet add package

limitations.text: Does not render PSD/PSB content or support pixel editing.
Does not export to raster formats such as PNG or JPEG.
Does not interpret full Photoshop feature set semantically.
Image resources are exposed only through lightweight unknown-only summaries.

problems_solved.text: Enables reading document properties such as dimensions, color mode, and compression from PSD/PSB files without rendering.
Supports enumeration and modification of layer metadata including name, visibility, opacity, and geometry.
Preserves unsupported file sections as raw bytes during save, minimizing unintended side effects.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PSD.FOSS is a free open-source .NET library for inspecting and editing a limited subset of PSD/PSB metadata without rendering pixels.

uncertainties: Whether the package is published to NuGet or only built locally.
Exact set of supported image resource types and their metadata exposure.
Whether all layer types (e.g., text, adjustment, smart object) are fully supported.
Behavior when saving files with unsupported layer effects or blending modes.
Whether PSB files larger than typical PSDs are fully supported.
How coordinate transformations are handled for layer geometry edits.
Whether resource IDs or tagged blocks are exposed beyond raw byte preservation.
Whether the library handles multi-page PSB or large-document edge cases.

workflows.name: Load and inspect PSD/PSB
workflows.text: Load a PSD or PSB file from a path or stream and read document-level metadata.

workflows.name: Enumerate layers
workflows.text: Iterate over layers and read their basic properties such as name, bounds, visibility, and opacity.

workflows.name: Edit layer metadata
workflows.text: Modify supported layer properties including name, visibility, opacity, clipping, blend mode, and geometry.

workflows.name: Save without rendering
workflows.text: Save the updated file back to disk or stream without rendering pixels, preserving unsupported sections.
